effects.target: seismic activity in the surrounding area
effects.trigger: dissatisfaction with communication between SCP-8999 and the Foundation

evidence.locator: SCP-8999 possesses a degree of control over seismic activity in the surrounding area through unknown means, and have been responsible for tremors reaching magnitudes of up to 7.0 on the Richter Scale.

effects.trigger: a modified dumbwaiter lift system constructed in the parish basement
constraints: a modified dumbwaiter lift system constructed in the parish basement

evidence.locator: This communication has occurred exclusively through a modified dumbwaiter lift system constructed in the parish basement.

effects.trigger: attaching a camera or surveillance drone to the lift
constraints: the entities possess a desire to remain unseen

evidence.locator: Attempts to record footage of SCP-8999 by attaching a camera or surveillance drone to the lift have been unsuccessful.
